scope: Own factual source inspection notes; no redistributed classfiles or decompiled source. Not native acceptance.

aoa3:gas_blaster.special_impact_branch: Player OR tame animal owned by shooter receives EntityUtil.healEntity(target, 0.05f); branch returns true instead of inherited impact. No team check appears in this method.
aoa3:gas_blaster.healing_limit: Absolute float passed through to heal, not a percentage. Overall net rate and cancellation remain untested.
aoa3:gas_blaster.visual_contract: Underbody drum and rear canister do not authorize converting spirit resource to conventional ammunition.

aoa3:germinator.impact: Living-target effect builder uses the poison field, constructor integer50 and level(2). Do not interpret units or effective duration without EffectsLib path review.
aoa3:germinator.visual_contract: Salamander breath sight is cosmetic proposal, not a second damage stream.

aoa3:golder_bomber.extra_projectile: After inherited fire succeeds, server-side branch creates an additional GoldenCannonballEntity with positional constructor float0.325. Native projectile count, collision and resource capture remain required.

aoa3:luxon_stickler.impact: Calls inherited impact damage, then creates LuxonSticklerStuckEntity for a living target, then discards original projectile. Stuck-entity lifetime and effects not fully reviewed here.
aoa3:luxon_stickler.visual_contract: Drum appearance must not silently switch inventory ammo to Cannonball.

aoa3:bozo_blaster.visual_contract: Front horn support grip remains visual proposal; do not copy Bubble Horn earned blow-mode buffs automatically.
